test_cases.title: Every web service publishes a WSDL description
acs: DERIVED: Each .asmx service returns a WSDL document at ?WSDL - 28 services (survey 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The web services run at http://localhost:1935 and need no sign-in locally.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 28 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Send GET to http://localhost:1935/<service>?WSDL for the service in the row.

steps.expected: The body is an XML document.

steps.action: Check the response for an error page.
